school: 佛教翻译学/南海求法之学（以海路西行、系统传译根本说一切有部律的唐代译经家、旅行家）
historical_significance: 义净（635-713），俗姓张，字文明，齐州山人，唐代高僧、译经家、旅行家，与鸠摩罗什、真谛、玄奘并称中国四大译经家。少年慕法显之业绩、玄奘之风范，立志西行；咸亨二年（671）三十七岁自广州取海路赴天竺——前贤多走陆路，义净独取南海航线，经室利佛逝（今苏门答腊巨港）、末罗瑜、羯荼而至印度，遍历三十余国、在外二十五载；在那烂陀寺研学，两度长驻室利佛逝，其间写定《南海寄归内法传》四卷与《大唐西域求法高僧传》二卷，托商船先送回广州并附书嘱请抄写流通——'成果先于本人归国'的托付设计；证圣元年（695）携梵本约四百部归抵洛阳，武则天亲迎于上东门外；此后二十余年先后主持佛授记寺、大福先寺、荐福寺译场，组织译主、证义、证文、笔受、缀文、参译、刊定、润文八道工序的流水线翻译，译出《金光明最胜王经》《药师琉璃光七佛本愿功德经》及根本说一切有部律十八部等共五十六部二百三十卷；著《梵语千字文》以千字对照表系统化梵汉对音。他一生以'亲验'对抗'传闻'，以'行持'统摄'义理'，以'译场工程'替代'个人英雄'，为五十余位同行求法僧立传而不独彰己功；先天二年（713）圆寂，塔于洛阳。其海路记录成为唐代南海交通史的第一手文献，其译场制度成为后世大型知识工程的先声。
historical_significance_en: Yijing (635-713), lay surname Zhang, courtesy name Wenming, a native of Qizhou — Tang monk, translator and traveler, ranked with Kumarajiva, Paramartha and Xuanzang among China's four great translators. In boyhood he admired Faxian's deeds and Xuanzang's example and vowed to go west; in 671, aged thirty-seven, he sailed from Guangzhou — where his predecessors took the land roads, Yijing alone chose the southern sea lanes, via Srivijaya (Palembang in Sumatra), Malayu and Kedah to India, passing through more than thirty lands in twenty-five years; he studied at Nalanda for a decade and twice sojourned long at Srivijaya, writing there the Record of Monastic Practices Sent Home from the Southern Seas in four fascicles and the Great Tang Biographies of Monks Who Sought the Law in the Western Regions in two, entrusting them to merchant ships for Guangzhou ahead of himself with letters asking for copying and circulation — a design in which results preceded their author home. In 695 he reached Luoyang with some four hundred Sanskrit texts, met by Empress Wu outside the Shangdong Gate; over the next two decades he directed the translation bureaus of the Foshouji, Dafuxian and Jianfu temples, organizing the eight-station pipeline of master translator, doctrine-verifier, text-verifier, recorder, stylist, cross-checker, editor and polisher, and produced fifty-six works in 230 fascicles — the Suvarnaprabhasa, the Medicine Buddha sutra, eighteen works of the Mulasarvastivada Vinaya and more; his Sanskrit Thousand-Character Text systematized Sanskrit-Chinese transliteration as a thousand-pair table. All his life he met hearsay with firsthand verification, subordinated doctrine to practice, and replaced the lone hero with the engineered bureau; he wrote lives for more than fifty fellow pilgrims without singling out his own. He died in 713, his stupa at Yanxing in Luoyang. His sea-route records are first-hand sources for the maritime history of Tang-era Southeast Asia, and his translation-bureau institutions an early blueprint of large-scale knowledge engineering.
unique_thinking: 义净思维模式的独特性在于'把求法变成工程'的总体方法论：(1)证据工程：不承认任何未经亲验的'知识'，以行程设计覆盖疑问清单，以'亲见/传闻'的证据等级标注每一记录——把求真变成可管理的核录作业；(2)行持优先的认识论：面对庞大戒律体系，先立可执行的日常动作规格，让行为的一致性反过来检验理解的纯正——细节即教义；(3)组织化知识生产：八道工序的译场流水线让跨语言知识移植脱离个人天才，质量由结构而非由英雄保证；(4)成果与生命的风险分离：著作先行寄运、事业成文交接、传承三线冗余——把'若我不归'当作可设计的问题求解，把集体记忆（为五十余同行立传）当作事业的完整形态。他证明：文明的对话不靠孤胆，靠工程。
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of Yijing's thinking lies in a total methodology of 'turning pilgrimage into engineering': (1) evidence engineering — no unverified claim counts as knowledge; the itinerary is designed to cover the checklist of open questions, every record tagged with its grade of evidence, seen versus heard, making truth-seeking a manageable auditing operation; (2) a practice-first epistemology — facing the vast Vinaya system, he first fixed executable specifications of daily acts, letting consistency of conduct audit the purity of understanding: the detail is the doctrine; (3) organized knowledge production — the eight-station translation pipeline detached cross-lingual transplantation from individual genius, quality guaranteed by structure rather than heroism; (4) the separation of results from the risks of one life — works shipped ahead, the enterprise handed over in writing, lineage redundancy on three lines, 'should I not return' solved as a designable problem, and collective memory (biographies of fifty fellow pilgrims) embraced as the full form of the undertaking. He proved that dialogue between civilizations rests not on lone courage but on engineering.
civilization_zh: 唐初的南海求法世界：义净（635-713），俗姓张，字文明，齐州山人；咸亨二年（671）三十七岁自广州取海路赴天竺，经室利佛逝、末罗瑜、羯荼而至那烂陀，历三十余国、二十五载；两度长驻室利佛逝研习声明学与根本说一切有部律，其间写定《南海寄归内法传》《大唐西域求法高僧传》托商船先送回广州；证圣元年（695）携梵本四百部归国，武则天亲迎于上东门外；先后主持洛阳、长安译场（佛授记寺、大福先寺、荐福寺），译经五十六部二百三十卷，与鸠摩罗什、真谛、玄奘并称四大译经家；景云二年（711）仍在译业，先天二年（713）圆寂，塔于延兴
civilization_en: The world of Tang sea-route pilgrims: Yijing (635-713), lay surname Zhang, courtesy name Wenming, a native of Qizhou; in 671, aged thirty-seven, he sailed from Guangzhou for India via Srivijaya, Malayu, Kedah and Nalanda, through more than thirty lands in twenty-five years; he twice stayed long at Srivijaya studying Sanskrit grammar and the Mulasarvastivada Vinaya, writing there the Record of Monastic Practices and the Biographies of Monks Who Sought the Law, sent home to Guangzhou by merchant ship ahead of himself; in 695 he returned with four hundred Sanskrit texts, met by Empress Wu outside the Shangdong Gate; he directed translation bureaus at Luoyang and Chang'an (Foshouji, Dafuxian, Jianfu temples), translating fifty-six works in 230 fascicles, ranked with Kumarajiva, Paramartha and Xuanzang as one of the four great translators; still at the work in 711, he died in 713, his stupa at Yanxing
key_works: 根本说一切有部律十八部（译）

cross_references.description_zh: 义净与郑和同为明代以前中国南海航海记录的开创者而取向相反：郑和以国家舰队七下西洋，牵星过洋、针路簿记，留下官方航海档案；义净以一人商船西行求法，逐程记录季风、国度与航程时日，留下民间求法的航行实录。一个是'国家的海洋'，一个是'信仰的海洋'——两者共同构成唐明两代南海知识体系的两极，也共同把航线从经验变成可复用的公共数据。
cross_references.description_en: Yijing and Zheng He, both founders of Chinese maritime records of the Southern Ocean before the modern age, took opposite bearings: Zheng He sailed with state fleets on seven voyages, star-guided, compass-route books in hand, leaving the official nautical archive; Yijing sailed west as one pilgrim on merchant ships, logging leg by leg the monsoons, kingdoms and passage days, leaving the private record of religious travel. One is the ocean of the state, the other the ocean of faith — together they mark the two poles of the Tang-and-Ming knowledge system of the southern seas, and together turned routes from experience into reusable public data.

cross_references.description_zh: 义净与朱舜水同为'文化跨海移植'的巨匠而方向相对：朱舜水明亡后蹈海东渡，把礼制、营造、实学带到日本水户，在异邦保存文明；义净唐初蹈海南渡，把律法、声明、行持从印度带回本土，在故土移植文明。一个'送出去'，一个'带回来'——两人共同证明：文明的存续不系于一地一国的存亡，而系于是否有人愿意渡海并设计好渡海的每一个环节。
cross_references.description_en: Yijing and Zhu Shunshui, both master engineers of 'transplanting culture across the sea', sailed in opposite directions: after the Ming fell, Zhu crossed the sea east to Japan, bringing ritual, architecture and practical learning to Mito, preserving a civilization abroad; at the Tang's height Yijing crossed the sea south and returned, bringing Vinaya, grammar and practice from India home, transplanting a civilization in his native land. One 'sent out', one 'brought back' — together they prove that civilization's survival rests not on any one land or dynasty but on whether someone will cross the sea and design every link of the crossing.

cross_references.description_zh: 义净与香农同以'信息跨系统传递'为核心关切而立场两极：香农把信息抽象为与意义无关的比特，追求传输效率的最大化；义净坚持意义与载体不可分割，名相咒语必须存原音原形、亲验必须抵达现场——翻译即是有损压缩，宁牺牲流畅不牺牲真义。一个把'传'优化到极致，一个把'真'守护到极致，共同构成信息传递问题中效率与保真的两端。
cross_references.description_en: Yijing and Claude Shannon, both centered on 'transmitting information across systems', stand at opposite poles: Shannon abstracted information into bits indifferent to meaning, maximizing transmission efficiency; Yijing insisted meaning and carrier are inseparable — technical terms and mantras must keep their original sound and form, verification must reach the site — translation is lossy compression, and fluency may be sacrificed but truth may not. One optimized transmission to the limit, the other guarded fidelity to the limit: the two ends of efficiency and faithfulness in the problem of communicating across systems.

cross_references.description_zh: 义净与司马迁同以'为人物立传'保存集体记忆而对象互补：司马迁为帝王将相之外的刺客、游侠、货殖者立传，把边缘人物写进正史；义净为五十余位无名求法僧立传，把同行者而非自己写进西行史。一个'究天人之际'的历史全景，一个'不书其名谁识斯俊'的求法名录——两人共同把'无名者的贡献'变成历史书写的正当对象。
cross_references.description_en: Yijing and Sima Qian, both preserving collective memory through biography, complemented each other's subjects: Sima Qian wrote lives of assassins, wandering knights and merchants — the marginal, into official history; Yijing wrote lives of more than fifty unnamed pilgrim monks, his fellow travelers rather than himself into the history of the westward quest. One the panoramic history 'exploring heaven and human affairs', the other the roster 'if their names are not written, who will know these worthies' — together they made the unnamed's contribution a legitimate object of historical writing.

modes.name_en: The Method of the Comparison Register
modes.domain_zh: 把'域外传闻'降格为'待验证假设'，必须亲至其地、对照原文与实物逐条核录后才升格为知识——以个人行迹为证据链，用一手记录替代转手传闻
modes.domain_en: Demote every 'overseas report' to a hypothesis, to be promoted to knowledge only after reaching the place and checking each item against original texts and things seen — the traveler's own trace becomes the chain of evidence, firsthand record replacing relayed rumor
modes.source_chapter: 咸亨二年（671）自广州取海路赴天竺，历三十余国；《南海寄归内法传》自述亲承诸国现行法式而录之
modes.key_quote_zh: 然则神州持律，时人乐涉繁词；天竺圣规，人力罕窥全际。思欲具牒，庶镜物无隐——故依根本说一切有部，录其行法
modes.key_quote_en: 'In the divine land, those holding the Vinaya delight in sprawling verbiage; the sagely rules of India, human effort can hardly survey in full. I wished to record them whole so the mirror would hide nothing — following the Mūlasarvāstivāda I set down their practices.'
process_zh: 把流传说法全部列成'待核清单'：凡非亲见者一律标注为传闻，不因其载于旧籍而免除核验义务
设计能覆盖清单的行程：以疑问点决定路线，让每个待核条目都对应一个可抵达的现场
现场逐条对照：以原文、原物、原制度为基准记录差异，注明'亲见/得自传闻'的证据等级
归国后以对照录刷新本土知识：重译重注，让新版取代旧说，并开放给后来者续核
process_en: List every current claim as a checklist to verify: whatever is not personally witnessed is tagged hearsay, its presence in old books never excusing it from verification
Design the itinerary to cover the checklist: let open questions determine the route, so each item corresponds to a site one can reach
Compare item by item on site: record differences against original texts, objects and institutions, marking the evidence grade — seen with one's own eyes versus heard
On return, refresh native knowledge with the comparison register: retranslate, reannotate, let the new edition supersede the old, and leave it open for successors to verify further
representative_cases_zh: 咸亨二年（671）年已三十七仍决意取海路赴天竺：法显陆去海还、玄奘陆去陆还，义净独取海路，因南海诸国正是律法传承的关键现场
在室利佛逝（今巨港）停留研习声明学与根本说一切有部律，前后近两年：把'中转站'变成'研究站'，按疑问点设计停留
《南海寄归内法传》记食坐方式、用水净秽、衣服仪式等四十余条，条条注明天竺与南海诸国实际奉行情况，对照本土传抄之误
representative_cases_en: In 671, already thirty-seven, he resolved on the sea route to India: Faxian went by land and returned by sea, Xuanzang by land both ways, but Yijing alone chose the sea, for the lands of the Southern Ocean were precisely the living sites of Vinaya transmission
He stayed at Srivijaya (Palembang) nearly two years studying Sanskrit grammar and the Mūlasarvāstivāda Vinaya — turning a waypoint into a research station,停留 designed by open questions

The Record of Monastic Practices Sent Home from the Southern Seas details over forty items — sitting at meals, use of water, dress and ritual — each noted with what India and the southern lands actually practice, against the errors of native transcription
modern_applications_zh: 市场调研的'现场主义'：海外情报一律标注可信等级，关键假设必须有人亲赴现场核验后才能进入决策
技术选型的'一手基准测试'：不引用厂商白皮书结论，凡进入选型的性能数字必须本团队复测并注明测试环境
个人学习的'证据分级'：读书笔记区分'书中说/我验证过'，只把后者当作可依赖的结论
modern_applications_en: Field-first market research: tag all foreign intelligence with confidence grades; no key hypothesis enters a decision until someone has verified it on site
Firsthand benchmarking in tech selection: never cite a vendor's whitepaper; every performance figure in a shortlist must be retested by the team with environment noted
Evidence grading in personal learning: notes distinguish 'the book says' from 'I verified'; only the latter counts as dependable
representative_figures: 义净（核心）
法显（先行：陆去海还的求法对照范式开创者）
玄奘（对照：陆路求法系统译经的另一极）
马林诺夫斯基（对照：参与式田野观察的现代同构）
modes.definition_zh: 把'域外传闻'降格为'待验证假设'，必须亲至其地、对照原文与实物逐条核录后才升格为知识——以个人行迹为证据链，用一手记录替代转手传闻
modes.definition_en: Demote every 'overseas report' to a hypothesis, to be promoted to knowledge only after reaching the place and checking each item against original texts and things seen — the traveler's own trace becomes the chain of evidence, firsthand record replacing relayed rumor

modes.domain_zh: 面对庞大的理论体系，不先攻义理而先立'可执行的日常行持'：把抽象规范翻译成穿衣、吃饭、用水等可核查的具体动作，以行为的一致性反过来保障理解的纯正
modes.domain_en: Facing a vast theoretical system, do not attack doctrine first but establish 'executable daily practice': translate abstract norms into checkable concrete acts — dressing, eating, using water — letting consistency of conduct guard the purity of understanding in return
modes.source_chapter: 《南海寄归内法传》四卷，专记诸国僧团日常行法；义净以为律学之要在行持不在论辩
modes.key_quote_zh: 凡此行法，人若依行，则道业无亏；若弃而不行，读诵虽多，终无利益
modes.key_quote_en: 'Should one follow these practices, the path suffers no loss; should one abandon them, however much one recites, there is no benefit at all.'
process_zh: 把抽象规范拆解为最小可执行单元：从'持戒'这类总目下沉到'如何洗手、如何坐、如何受食'的具体动作规格
为每个动作确立可观察的判准：对错不靠自我声明，而靠在场者共同可见的行为标准
以日复一日的执行积累'行持惯性'：让规范变成不需要意志力维持的默认动作
定期用行持检验理解：凡行为与教义陈述矛盾处，先怀疑理解而非辩护行为
process_en: Decompose abstract norms into minimal executable units: descend from the general heading 'keeping the precepts' to concrete specifications of how to wash, sit, and receive food
Set an observable criterion for each act: right and wrong rest not on self-report but on standards visible to everyone present
Accumulate the inertia of practice through daily execution, turning norms into default actions that need no willpower to sustain
Test understanding by practice at intervals: wherever conduct contradicts a doctrinal statement, suspect the understanding first, never defend the conduct
representative_cases_zh: 《寄归传》以整卷篇幅记'食坐小隅''用水之别'：洗手几遍、用何器、坐何方位——把戒律落到最细的日常规格
归途重驻室利佛逝写定《一百五十赞佛颂》译本与《寄归传》：译经之前先固定'可行之法'，让理论著作与行为规范配套落地
归国后主持译场仍以律行为先：荐福寺译场规制严格，先后次第、场内分工皆有成文——把'行持优先'同样应用于学术组织
representative_cases_en: The Record devotes whole chapters to 'sitting at meals' and 'the differing uses of water': how many washings, what vessels, which seat — doctrine brought down to the finest daily specification

On his return voyage he stayed again at Srivijaya to finalize the translation of the 150 Verses of Praise and the Record: before theory, fix the practicable rules, letting scholarly work and behavioral norms land as a set

Back home he ran the translation bureau still with practice first: strict regulations at the Jianfu Temple bureau, written procedures for sequence and division of labor — 'practice-first' applied to organizing scholarship itself
modern_applications_zh: 组织规范的'行为化落法'：价值观不写在墙上而翻译成可观察的行为清单，考核对事不对表态
安全工程中的'规程优先'：不靠口头强调安全意识，把安全翻译成强制检查点与默认动作
个人习惯设计：把'变得更好'改写为每日三个可核查的具体动作，用执行惯性替代动机
modern_applications_en: Behavioral codification in organizations: values not on the wall but as observable behavior checklists, assessed by deeds not declarations
Procedure-first safety engineering: not verbal emphasis on awareness, but safety translated into mandatory checkpoints and default actions
Personal habit design: rewrite 'becoming better' as three checkable daily acts, letting execution inertia replace motivation

道宣（对照：本土律学义章化的另一路径）
怀海（下承：'一日不作一日不食'的清规行持化）

modes.name_en: The Method of the Translation Works
modes.domain_zh: 把个人不能完成的跨语言知识移植，设计成多角色流水线：译主、证义、证文、笔受、缀文、参译、刊定、润文各司其职，用组织结构而非个人天才保证海量翻译的质量与速度
modes.domain_en: Design cross-lingual knowledge transplantation, impossible for one person, as a multi-role assembly line: master translator, doctrine-verifier, text-verifier, recorder, stylist, cross-checker, editor, polisher each in their station — organizational structure, not individual genius, guaranteeing quality and throughput at scale
modes.source_chapter: 证圣元年（695）归国后主持译场，先后于洛阳佛授记寺、大福先寺、长安荐福寺译经五十六部二百三十卷
modes.key_quote_zh: 译之大纲，其流有八……始自译主，终于润文，八职相须，阙一不可
modes.key_quote_en: 'The grand outline of translation flows in eight stations... from the master translator to the final polisher, the eight roles require one another; lacking any one, nothing stands.'
process_zh: 把最终产物拆解为工序链：理解原文、核定义理、核对文本、成笔、缀连、双语对照参校、刊定体例、润色文采——每道工序单列
为每道工序配置专职角色并定其职责边界：不让一个角色既定标准又自评质量
以制度衔接工序：先后次第、交接物、异议处理皆有成文，使协作不依赖私人默契
以产量与质量双指标运营译场：五十六部二百三十卷的规模证明流水线可持续，而非一时盛举
process_en: Decompose the final product into a chain of operations: grasping the source, verifying doctrine, checking text, drafting, joining, bilingual cross-checking, fixing style, polishing — each operation named apart
Staff each operation with a dedicated role and boundary of duty: no role both sets the standard and grades its own work
Lash the operations together by institution: sequence, deliverables, and dispute handling all written down, so collaboration rests on no private rapport
Run the works on twin metrics of output and quality: fifty-six texts in 230 fascicles prove the line sustainable, not a one-season wonder
representative_cases_zh: 久视之后主持实叉难陀《华严经》八十卷新译参与协理，后自领译场译《金光明最胜王经》《药师琉璃光七佛本愿功德经》等：按部帙大小调配工序与人力
荐福寺译场与吐火罗语、梵语出身的多族译人协作（如达摩末摩等）：跨语言团队按工序而非按师承分工
所译《梵本千手千眼观世音菩萨广大圆满无碍大悲心陀罗尼经》等密部经典保留梵音对音规则：音译环节专设'参译'对校，不使一人裁定
representative_cases_en: After 699 he helped coordinate the new eighty-fascicle Avatamsaka under Shikshananda, then led his own bureau translating the Suvarnaprabhasa and the Medicine Buddha sutra: staffing and procedure scaled to each work's size
At the Jianfu bureau he worked with translators of Tokharian and Sanskrit background (such as Dharmamitra): a polyglot team divided by station, not by lineage
In esoteric texts like the Great Compassion Dharani he fixed rules for transliterating Sanskrit sounds: the transliteration stage had its own cross-checker, never one man's ruling
modern_applications_zh: 大型内容工程的'工序化'：百科、词典、代码文档按'撰写/审义/核文/润色'分职，质量不押在个人身上
机器翻译的'人机流水线'：机译初笔、专家证义、语言润文——八职结构的现代复刻
开源项目的角色矩阵：maintainer/reviewer/committer 分立，用流程而非默契保证合并质量
modern_applications_en: Process-splitting in large content works: encyclopedias, dictionaries, code docs divided into drafting, doctrine-review, text-check, polishing — quality not staked on individuals
The human-machine translation pipeline: machine first draft, expert doctrine check, linguistic polish — the eight stations reborn
Role matrix in open source: maintainer, reviewer, committer kept separate, process rather than rapport guarding merge quality
representative_figures: 义净（核心）
玄奘（先行：国家译场与'五不翻'体例的奠基者）
实叉难陀（协作：《华严》八十卷译场主译）
剑桥词典编纂团队（对照：多工序词典工程的组织同构）
modes.definition_zh: 把个人不能完成的跨语言知识移植，设计成多角色流水线：译主、证义、证文、笔受、缀文、参译、刊定、润文各司其职，用组织结构而非个人天才保证海量翻译的质量与速度
modes.definition_en: Design cross-lingual knowledge transplantation, impossible for one person, as a multi-role assembly line: master translator, doctrine-verifier, text-verifier, recorder, stylist, cross-checker, editor, polisher each in their station — organizational structure, not individual genius, guaranteeing quality and throughput at scale

modes.name_en: The Method of the Sea-Lane Gazetteer
modes.domain_zh: 沿航线把未知海域转成可复用的地理知识：逐程记里程、风向、季候、物产、国度与航程所需时日，使一次航行的私人经验变成他人可循的公共航道
modes.domain_en: Along the sailing route, convert unknown waters into reusable geographic knowledge: leg by leg record distances, winds, seasons, products, kingdoms and days of passage — turning one voyage's private experience into a public lane others can follow
modes.source_chapter: 《大唐西域求法高僧传》记并州道希、爱州大乘灯等五十余位西行僧之行迹与海陆路线
modes.key_quote_zh: 观夫自古神州之地，轻生殉法之宾……孤步帆间，独逝波上，或亡餐几日，辍饮数晨
modes.key_quote_en: 'From of old in the divine land, guests who spent their lives for the Dharma... alone they stepped between sails, passed solitary over the waves, days without meals, mornings without drink.'
process_zh: 把行程切成标准记录单元：出发地、方向、里数、风候、时日、所至国——每段航程按同一格式记
记录'失败与代价'而非只记成功：同行殁于海者、迷航者、病殁者皆入传，让风险本身成为知识
标注航线的季节约束：哪些月份可发、何港须避、季风何时转向——把航海经验压缩成历法
使记录面向后来者：名录与路线合编成传，让后人的出发决策建立在完整数据之上
process_en: Cut the voyage into standard record units: origin, bearing, distance, wind-season, days, kingdom reached — every leg logged in the same format
Record failure and cost, not success alone: those lost at sea, astray, or dead of illness all enter the biographies, risk itself becoming knowledge
Mark the seasonal constraints of each lane: which months to sail, which ports to shun, when the monsoon turns — compressing seafaring experience into a calendar
Aim the record at those who come after: roster and routes compiled into one book, so later departures rest on complete data
representative_cases_zh: 《大唐西域求法高僧传》记僧哲、灵运、大乘灯等经海路往还诸国及航程见闻：为唐代南海航线留下最早的系统中文记录之一
自述广州出发'南持占波，至室利佛逝'的航程次第：把季风节律写进行程设计
为同时代无名西行者立传五十余人，兼记其'或从北道，或从南道'：路线选择的成败一并保留
representative_cases_en: The Great Tang Biographies of Monks Who Sought the Law in the Western Regions logs Sengzhe, Lingyun, Dasheng Deng and others on sea routes through many kingdoms — among the earliest systematic Chinese records of the Tang Southern-Ocean lanes
His own itinerary from Guangzhou 'south past Champa to Srivijaya' bakes the monsoon rhythm into route design
He wrote biographies for over fifty otherwise unnamed pilgrims, noting each 'by the northern or the southern road': the successes and failures of route choice kept together
modern_applications_zh: 远洋物流的'航线档案'：逐航次记录气象窗口、油耗、引水与港序，形成组织资产而非个人经验
登山/探险领域的'路线志'：记录失败与折返点，让后来者的风险评估建立在完整样本上
创业生态的'路径复盘'：不只传颂成功案例，把失败路径同样归档为公共知识
modern_applications_en: Lane archives in ocean logistics: each voyage logs weather windows, fuel, pilots and port order — an organizational asset, not private experience
Route journals in mountaineering and exploration: failures and turn-back points recorded so later risk assessments rest on full samples
Path post-mortems in startup ecosystems: failures archived as public knowledge alongside the celebrated successes
representative_figures: 义净（核心）
法显（先行：《佛国记》所记海路归程为蓝本之一）
贾耽（对照：以职方之职系统绘制海陆交通图志）
马可·波罗（对照：同以行旅记录跨文明地理而路径相反）
modes.definition_zh: 沿航线把未知海域转成可复用的地理知识：逐程记里程、风向、季候、物产、国度与航程所需时日，使一次航行的私人经验变成他人可循的公共航道
modes.definition_en: Along the sailing route, convert unknown waters into reusable geographic knowledge: leg by leg record distances, winds, seasons, products, kingdoms and days of passage — turning one voyage's private experience into a public lane others can follow

modes.domain_zh: 翻译时不以本土文风削足适履：能意译处求达，凡名相、数术、仪轨则存其原音原形，宁使读者费力也不曲解原义——以译文的'硬'保全原典信息的完整
modes.domain_en: In translation, never cut the source to fit native style: where sense can be conveyed freely, seek fluency, but for technical terms, numerals and rites keep the original sound and form — better to tax the reader than bend the meaning, the 'hardness' of the translation preserving the source's information whole
modes.source_chapter: 义净译《金光明最胜王经》《入楞伽心玄义》等，主张'若饰文失旨，则埋没圣言'；用字存梵音如'涅槃'不复作'无为'
modes.key_quote_zh: 与其饰文而失旨，不若直质而存真
modes.key_quote_en: 'Better plain truth than polished loss: rather straight and unadorned, keeping the real, than embellished prose that loses the point.'
process_zh: 区分'可译层'与'必须存真层'：叙事与说理可求通达，名相、咒语、数术、仪轨保留原音原形
为术语建立固定对译规则并一以贯之：同一梵词在同一批译籍中不换译名，使术语可检索可比对
对音规则化：梵音汉字对音采用固定字表，使后人可以逆推原音
以注释补足直译造成的隔阂：不为迁就读者改译文，而以玄义、音义等辅助文本解释难点
process_en: Separate the translatable layer from the must-preserve layer: narrative and argument may seek fluency; technical terms, mantras, numerals and rites keep original sound and form
Fix rules for term equivalents and hold to them: one Sanskrit word keeps one rendering across a whole corpus, so terms stay searchable and comparable
Systematize transliteration: a fixed table of Sanskrit-to-Chinese sound correspondences lets later readers reconstruct the original sounds
Bridge the rigors of literalism with commentary: do not bend the text to ease the reader; explain the hard points in auxiliary works of meaning and philology
representative_cases_zh: 重译《金光明最胜王经》十卷，较旧译增补'如意宝珠品'等：以梵本为据补阙而不迁就旧本
咒语、陀罗尼一律'存梵音而不翻'：大悲咒等密部文本在其译场定型为对音规则统一的版本
著《梵语千字文》（梵唐千字文）：以千字对照表把梵汉对音变成可学习的固定规则，兼供入竺者实用
representative_cases_en: His retranslation of the Suvarnaprabhasa in ten fascicles restored the Cintamani chapter missing from the old version: source-based supplement, no concession to the previous text
Mantras and dharanis were 'kept in Sanskrit sound, never translated': esoteric texts like the Great Compassion Dharani took their definitive form in his bureau under unified transliteration rules
His Sanskrit-Thousand-Character Text fixed Sanskrit-Chinese sound correspondence as a learnable table — practical for pilgrims and rule for translators alike
modern_applications_zh: 学术翻译的'术语表纪律'：关键概念建立固定译名并全文统一，宁加注释不改术语
软件本地化的'键值不译'原则：代码标识符、协议字段保留原文，只译界面层
法务与医学翻译的'原文存真'：条款编号、药品名、剂量单位一律保留原形，注释另行处理歧义
modern_applications_en: Glossary discipline in academic translation: fixed renderings for key concepts throughout, annotation rather than alteration
Keep-as-is rule in software localization: identifiers and protocol fields stay in the source language; only the UI layer is translated
Source fidelity in legal and medical translation: clause numbers, drug names, dosage units always preserved; ambiguity handled in notes
representative_figures: 义净（核心）
玄奘（先行：'五不翻'原则的提出者）
鸠摩罗什（对照：意译畅达的另一极）
路德维希·维特根斯坦（对照：术语系统自创自守的哲学写作）

modes.name_en: The Method of the Bilingual Pairing
modes.domain_zh: 把跨语言知识做成'双语并存'的文献结构：梵汉对照、音义并列、原本与译文同存——不假定哪一方是最终版本，让两种语言互相校验、互为备份
modes.domain_en: Build cross-lingual knowledge as a bilingual document structure: Sanskrit and Chinese side by side, sound and gloss juxtaposed, original and translation coexisting — never presuming which is final, letting the two languages check and back up each other
modes.source_chapter: 著《梵语千字文》以梵汉千字对照供入竺者习用；译籍中存梵音咒语与汉译经文并行
modes.key_quote_zh: 习梵文者，须凭此千字，则天竺文体略可通晓
modes.key_quote_en: 'Who studies Sanskrit should rely on this thousand characters; with them the literary form of India may be broadly understood.'
process_zh: 为双语结构选定对照单元：以字、词或条目为粒度，使每一单元两侧内容一一对应
固定对音与对译规则：同一音节、同一术语在全部文献中用法一致，使对照可学习、可逆推
让双语互相承担校验功能：译文可疑处以原文为裁，原文残缺处以译文为据
把对照结构做成教学工具：从'文献格式'降维成'可习得课程'，让后来者能沿此进入原语言
process_en: Choose the unit of pairing — character, word, or entry — so each unit corresponds one to one across the two languages
Fix rules of transliteration and equivalence: one sound, one term, one usage across all documents, making the pairing learnable and reversible
Let the two languages serve as each other's check: where the translation is suspect, judge by the source; where the source is corrupt, rely on the translation
Turn the paired structure into a teaching tool: from document format down to a learnable course, letting successors enter the source language along it
representative_cases_zh: 《梵语千字文》以一千个梵汉对照字串成四字韵语：既是文献对照表又是入竺者的梵文入门课本
译经中咒语存梵音、经文出汉译，同卷并行：读诵与理解各取所需，互不相扰
《南海寄归内法传》记天竺声明学纲要（四十九字基、八界论等）：把原语言的结构知识一并写入行记
representative_cases_en: The Sanskrit Thousand-Character Text strings a thousand Sanskrit-Chinese pairs into four-character rhymes: at once a concordance and a primer for pilgrims
In his translations mantras keep Sanskrit sound while sutra text appears in Chinese, side by side in one roll: recitation and understanding each served, neither disturbed
The Record sketches the framework of Indian grammar (the forty-nine letters, the eightfold declension): the structural knowledge of the source language written into the travel account itself
modern_applications_zh: 国际化文档的'双语对照'结构：法律合同、API 文档中英文并排，术语表统一，两侧互为校验
数据库的'双写备份'：关键数据同时写入两种表示（原格式+规范化格式），互为恢复源
语言学习产品的'对照语料'：以双语平行语料替代单语教材，学习者直接在真实文献上习得
modern_applications_en: Bilingual pairing in international documents: contracts and API docs with English and Chinese in parallel, one glossary, each side checking the other
Dual-write backups in databases: key data written in two representations, original plus normalized, each a recovery source for the other
Parallel corpora in language-learning products: bilingual aligned texts replacing monolingual primers, learned directly from real documents
representative_figures: 义净（核心）
守温（下承：汉语等韵字母之学的对音传统）
马礼逊（对照：近代双语词典工程的同一结构）
玄奘（先行：译场梵汉对音的奠基）

modes.definition_en: Build cross-lingual knowledge as a bilingual document structure: Sanskrit and Chinese side by side, sound and gloss juxtaposed, original and translation coexisting — never presuming which is final, letting the two languages check and back up each other

modes.name_en: The Method of the Fellow-Pilgrims' Lives
modes.domain_zh: 不把成就归于孤胆英雄，而为同时代同行者立传：记下每一位同路人出发的动机、路线与结局，使集体事业的完整图景代替个人叙事——无名者的贡献成为历史的一部分
modes.domain_en: Credit no achievement to a lone hero: write biographies of every fellow traveler of the age — motives, routes, and ends of each companion — letting the full picture of a collective undertaking replace the personal narrative, the unnamed becoming part of history
modes.source_chapter: 《大唐西域求法高僧传》二卷，为玄照、道希、道生、大乘灯、僧哲等五十余位西行求法僧立传
modes.key_quote_zh: 斯并策鹄霞轨，追风骛迹……或望影而没命，或闻钟而丧躯。不书其名，谁识斯俊？
modes.key_quote_en: 'These all took the crane-track through the clouds, chasing the wind's traces... some spent their lives chasing a shadow, some died at the sound of a bell. If their names are not written, who will know these worthies?'
process_zh: 盘点事业的全部参与者而不只记'成功者'：凡同赴一业者——成行、中途、殁于道——皆入名册
为每人记录最小可传事实集：籍贯、出发年、路线、所至、结局，体例统一
在己传中自处其列：把自己也写成同行者之一，不作事业的唯一主角
使名录成为制度记忆：后来者查名录即知前代全部尝试，包括失败者所排除的路线
process_en: Take stock of every participant in the enterprise, not only the winners: all who set out on the same work — completed, turned back, or dead on the road — enter the roster
Record for each a minimal set of transmissible facts: origin, year of departure, route, places reached, end — one uniform template
Place yourself within the list: write yourself as one fellow pilgrim among many, never the sole protagonist of the undertaking
Make the roster institutional memory: successors consult it for every previous attempt, including the routes the failed have ruled out
representative_cases_zh: 为并州道希、爱州大乘灯、新罗慧轮等不同籍贯僧人立传：求法者中还有新罗、爱州（今越南）人——集体图景超越单一王朝视角
记玄照法师三度往返、终于 bhutan 之地'请谒无由'的困局：失败与受挫同功业一样入传
自传居末，仅二百余字自述行程：五十余传中，义净把自己写成普通一员
representative_cases_en: He wrote lives of Daoxi of Bingzhou, Dasheng Deng of Ai (Annam), Hyerun of Silla and others: among the pilgrims were men of Silla and Vietnam — a collective picture beyond any single dynasty's view
He recorded Master Xuanzhao's three round journeys and his final plight of 'no way to present his petition': failure and setback entered the record alongside achievement
His own autobiography stands last, barely two hundred characters: among fifty-odd lives, Yijing wrote himself as one ordinary member
modern_applications_zh: 科研项目的'贡献者全景'：论文与工程致谢之外，为每一轮尝试（含失败分支）保留可检索的参与者记录
开源项目的 CONTRIBUTORS 与'失败 RFC 归档'：被拒绝的提案与被合并的提案同样可查
组织史编写：不写'创始英雄传'，而写全员名录与完整尝试史，让后来者理解全部路径
modern_applications_en: Full contributor views in research projects: beyond acknowledgments, searchable records of participants in every attempt, failed branches included
CONTRIBUTORS files and rejected-RFC archives in open source: denied proposals as retrievable as merged ones
Organizational histories written as rosters and complete attempt histories, not founder epics, so successors grasp every path
representative_figures: 义净（核心）
慧皎（先行：《高僧传》传记体例的开创者）
司马迁（对照：为刺客游侠等边缘人物立传的史学传统）
普鲁塔克（对照：以并列传记保存多重记忆的西方同构）

modes.definition_en: Credit no achievement to a lone hero: write biographies of every fellow traveler of the age — motives, routes, and ends of each companion — letting the full picture of a collective undertaking replace the personal narrative, the unnamed becoming part of history

modes.name_en: The Method of the Beforehand Entrustment
modes.domain_zh: 在不可逆行动之前，先把'若我不归'的全部安排托付清楚：著作寄存何处、译业交于何人、写给谁的信留作凭证——以事前的托付消解单点死亡对事业的毁灭性
modes.domain_en: Before any irreversible act, settle in advance everything 'should I not return': where works are deposited, who inherits the translation enterprise, what letters stand as proof — dissolving the destructive power of single-point death through prior entrustment
modes.source_chapter: 在室利佛逝期间托商船将《南海寄归内法传》《大唐西域求法高僧传》先送回广州，并附书嘱请代为抄写流通
modes.key_quote_zh: 愿持二传附归唐使……庶斯圣迹，不坠于地
modes.key_quote_en: 'I entrust these two records to those sailing home... so that these sacred traces may never fall to the ground.'
process_zh: 识别行动的'单点死亡'风险：行程、海难、疾病皆可能让知识随人俱亡
把可分离的成果先行送出：著作、数据、记录随可靠载体提前归返，不与本人同船同命运
为未竟事业指定继承人并明示其职责：译业由谁主持、与谁协作、资粮何来，成文而非口头
留下可验证的凭证与请托文书：使后方接手者有据可依、有名可凭，不需重建语境
process_en: Identify the single-point-death risk: voyage, shipwreck, illness may all let knowledge die with the man
Send separable results out ahead: works, data and records travel home on reliable carriers, never sharing the fate of their author's boat
Name a successor for the unfinished enterprise and state their charge: who leads, with whom they work, whence the resources — written, not oral
Leave verifiable credentials and letters of request, so those behind can act on evidence and standing, never rebuilding context from scratch
representative_cases_zh: 证圣元年（695）归国之前，早在室利佛逝即托遣将两部著作送回广州：成书于归途之前，寄运于本人之前
在佛逝附书广州僧俗，请代为抄写流通并护送入京：为成果指定'接收方'与'推广方'两个角色
归国后即投身译场二十四年至终老：个人若殁于归途，译业已有成文交接基础，不系于一人
representative_cases_en: Before his return in 695, he had already dispatched both works from Srivijaya to Guangzhou: written before the voyage home ended, shipped before the author sailed
From Srivijaya he sent letters to monks and laymen in Guangzhou asking them to copy, circulate and escort the works to the capital: designating both a receiver and a promoter for the results
On returning he threw himself into translation for twenty-four years to the end of his life: had he died at sea, the enterprise stood on written handover, not on one man
modern_applications_zh: 远洋科考与极地探险的'数据先行回传'：原始数据每日卫星回传，不与队伍同命运
关键岗位的'交接预案'：项目文档、密码托管、决策日志常备更新，任何时点都可交接
创业者的'法律与知识遗产'设计：股权、源码托管、文档密钥在冒险行动前先行安排
modern_applications_en: Data-home-first in oceanographic and polar expeditions: raw data satellite-relayed daily, never sharing the team's fate
Handover readiness for critical roles: project docs, credential escrow, decision logs kept current so handover is possible at any point
Founders' legal and knowledge estate: equity, code escrow, documentation keys settled before the risky move
representative_figures: 义净（核心）
法显（先行：归航时携带经像、备载沉船风险的同型处境）
威廉·莎士比亚（对照：身后文本托付问题的反面案例）
现代南极科考队（对照：数据先行回传的制度化同构）
modes.definition_zh: 在不可逆行动之前，先把'若我不归'的全部安排托付清楚：著作寄存何处、译业交于何人、写给谁的信留作凭证——以事前的托付消解单点死亡对事业的毁灭性
modes.definition_en: Before any irreversible act, settle in advance everything 'should I not return': where works are deposited, who inherits the translation enterprise, what letters stand as proof — dissolving the destructive power of single-point death through prior entrustment

modes.name_en: The Method of the Waystation Deep-Work
modes.domain_zh: 不在最远的终点也不在起点投入主力，而识别'中转站'的战略价值：在航路节点停留数年，把它经营成学习基地与成果中转港——让地理上的'之间'成为事业的重心
modes.domain_en: Invest your main effort neither at the farthest terminus nor at the origin, but recognize the strategic value of the waystation: stop years at a node on the route and build it into a study base and results relay — making the geographical 'in-between' the center of gravity of the work
modes.source_chapter: 两度长驻室利佛逝（约685-689、归途再驻），在此写定《寄归传》《求法传》并研习声明、律学
modes.key_quote_zh: 于时间，驻佛逝，习声明，写经送归——中间之地，正可为学
modes.key_quote_en: 'For a time he stayed at Srivijaya, studying grammar, copying works and sending them home — the land in between is precisely fit for learning.'
process_zh: 在全程地图上标出'节点'：既连通起点与终点、又具备资源（师资、文本、安全、补给）的位置
评估节点的'性价比'：终点未必条件最优，节点的稳定性与积累性可能远超终点
以数年为单位深耕节点：把停留从'过境'升级为'基地'——学习、著述、寄送皆在此完成
让节点承担成果中转：完成品经节点前置发送，终点只保留必须亲至的部分
process_en: Mark the nodes on the full-route map: places both connecting origin and terminus and endowed with resources — teachers, texts, safety, supply
Assess each node's yield: the terminus need not offer the best conditions; a node's stability and accumulation may far exceed it
Deep-work the node in units of years: upgrade the stay from 'transit' to 'base' — study, writing, and dispatch all done there
Let the node relay the results: finished works sent forward from it, the terminus keeping only what must be reached in person
representative_cases_zh: 咸亨四年（673）起在室利佛逝停留研习，后于685年返程再驻约四年：声明学与律学的主要功课在此完成，而非天竺本土
两部专著在佛逝写成并就地托运回国：中转站同时是'写作站'与'发运港'
归国后选长安荐福寺为译场基地：事业后期的'节点'不再是地理港口而是制度据点
representative_cases_en: From 673 he stayed at Srivijaya to study, and again nearly four years on the return from 685: his main work in grammar and Vinaya was done there, not in India proper
Both treatises were written at Srivijaya and shipped home from there: the waystation served at once as writing station and shipping port
Back home he chose the Jianfu Temple in Chang'an as his base: the late-career 'waystation' was no longer a geographic port but an institutional one
modern_applications_zh: 全球化团队的'枢纽选址'：总部与市场之外，把研发基地放在人才与成本的'之间'（如新加坡、里斯本）
职业发展的'中间层深耕'：不挤最高处的独木桥，而在产业链枢纽位置积累不可替代性
数据处理架构的'边缘节点'：计算与缓存下沉到离数据源最近的中间层，终点只做最终决策
modern_applications_en: Hub siting for global teams: beyond HQ and market, put the research base in the 'in-between' of talent and cost — Singapore, Lisbon
Deep-work at the middle layer of a career: not the crowded summit, but irreplaceability built at the hinge of the industry chain
Edge nodes in data architecture: computing and caching pushed to the middle layer nearest the source, the terminus reserving only final decisions
representative_figures: 义净（核心）
达·伽马（对照：以海上要冲为据点的殖民航海地理策略）
鉴真（同期：以扬州为节点六渡东海的据点策略）
丝路粟特商人（对照：以撒马尔罕等枢纽世代深耕的族群同构）

modes.definition_en: Invest your main effort neither at the farthest terminus nor at the origin, but recognize the strategic value of the waystation: stop years at a node on the route and build it into a study base and results relay — making the geographical 'in-between' the center of gravity of the work

modes.name_en: The Method of Designing the Lineage Continuity
modes.domain_zh: 把'我之后怎么办'当作可设计的问题：生前确立法脉的文本依据、传承人选与制度依托，使事业在个人身后仍沿既定轨道运行——传承不靠缘分靠设计
modes.domain_en: Treat 'what happens after me' as a designable problem: establish in life the textual basis, the successors and the institutional anchor of the lineage, so the work runs on its set rails after the person — continuity by design, not by chance
modes.source_chapter: 译场直至景云二年（711）仍在运作，圆寂前译业与法脉依托荐福寺制度延续；所传根本说一切有部律成为后世持律依据
modes.key_quote_en: 'May this lamp of the Dharma be handed on without end.'
process_zh: 为事业确立'可独立的文本基础'：核心知识必须落成文字与规程，不依附于任何个人的记忆
选定制度依托而非仅选个人：把事业挂靠在比个人寿命更长久的组织上（寺院、译场、学派）
在生前完成传承人选的实际操作训练：让继任者在有生之年已实际主持过部分工作
预设'若传承中断'的冗余：文本、制度、人选三线俱备，任一线断裂事业仍可复原
process_en: Establish an independent textual basis for the work: core knowledge set down in texts and procedures, attached to no one's memory
Choose an institutional anchor, not merely a person: hang the enterprise on an organization outliving any individual — monastery, translation bureau, school
Complete the successors' operational training in one's lifetime: let them actually direct parts of the work while the founder lives
Build in redundancy against broken succession: texts, institution and personnel as three lines, any one of which can restore the work if the others fail
representative_cases_zh: 系统翻译根本说一切有部律十八部：为一部律的传统提供完整文本基础，使'依何持律'不因人而异
把译业依托于荐福寺译场制度而非个人师徒关系：圆寂后译场仍有成文规程可循
生前培养弟子如智积等参与译事：继任者非临终指定，而是多年协作中自然形成
representative_cases_en: He systematically translated the Mūlasarvāstivāda Vinaya in eighteen works: a complete textual basis for one Vinaya tradition, so 'on what rule one keeps the precepts' never depended on a man
He anchored the translation enterprise in the institutional bureau of the Jianfu Temple rather than a personal master-disciple tie: after his death the bureau still had written rules to follow
In life he trained disciples in the work of translation: successors were not deathbed picks but grew from years of collaboration
modern_applications_zh: 创始人的'制度遗嘱'：把组织知识写入文档与流程、选定董事会而非单一接班人、生前让继任者实际操盘
开源项目的'归档转交'：BDFL 主动把治理权移交基金会，规范与流程先于人事安排
家族事业的'三线冗余'：章程文本、家族信托、职业经理人三条线并存，任一线断裂事业仍存
modern_applications_en: Founders' institutional will: organizational knowledge in docs and process, a board rather than a single heir, successors actually running things in the founder's lifetime
Archival handover in open source: the BDFL ceding governance to a foundation, norms and process preceding personnel changes
Three-line redundancy in family enterprise: charter, trust, professional managers in parallel — any one failing, the work survives
representative_figures: 义净（核心）
鉴真（对照：以传戒制度设计延续法脉的同期同构）
百丈怀海（下承：以清规制度固化丛林传承）
阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔（对照：以基金制度设计身后事业的世俗同构）
